options.name: args
options.description:
A dictionary of the optional arguments and their values used together with the command.
This translates {"name_arg": "value_arg"} to "--name_arg value_arg".

options.name: command
options.description:
The name of the Nautobot management command to run. Some command fully implemented are: C(createsuperuser),
C(migrate), C(makemigrations), C(post_upgrade) and C(collectstatic).
Other commands can be entered, but will fail if they're unknown to Nautobot or use positional arguments.
The module will perform some basic parameter validation, when applicable, to the commands.

options.name: flags
options.description: A list of flags to append to the command that is passed to C(nautobot-server), so that ["flag1", "flag2"] is translated to "--flag1 --flag2".

options.name: positional_args
options.description: A list of additional arguments to append to the end of the command that is passed to C(nautobot-server). These are appended to the end of the command, so that ["arg1", "arg2"] is translated to "arg1 arg2".

options.name: project_path
options.description: The path to the root of the Nautobot application where B(nautobot-server) lives.

options.name: pythonpath
options.description: A directory to add to the Python path. Typically used to include the settings module if it is located external to the application directory.

options.name: settings
options.description: The Python path to the application's settings module, such as 'myapp.settings'.

options.name: virtualenv
options.description: An optional path to a I(virtualenv) installation to use while running the nautobot-server application.
